args.content:
WITH OrderTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS siparis_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS tutar
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.id
),
CityStats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        COUNT(ot.siparis_id) AS siparis_sayisi,
        -- Medyan hesaplama için değerleri sıralıyoruz
        ot.tutar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.sehir ORDER BY ot.tutar ASC) as row_asc,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.sehir) as total_count
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    JOIN OrderTotals ot ON s.id = ot.siparis_id
),
MedianCalc AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        siparis_sayisi,
        AVG(tutar) as medyan
    FROM CityStats
    WHERE 
        -- Çift sayıda ise ortadaki iki değerin indeksi: n/2 ve n/2 + 1
        -- Tek sayıda ise tam orta indeks: (n+1)/2
        -- SQL'de row_asc ile kontrol etmek için:
        (total_count % 2 = 0 AND row_asc IN (total_count / 2, total_count / 2 + 1))
        OR 
        (total_count % 2 != 0 AND row_asc = (total_count + 1) / 2)
    GROUP BY sehir, siparis_sayisi
)
SELECT 
    sehir, 
    siparis_sayisi, 
    ROUND(medyan, 2) as medyan
FROM MedianCalc
WHERE siparis_sayisi >= 2
ORDER BY medyan DESC, sehir ASC;

CREATE TABLE musteriler (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ad TEXT NOT NULL, sehir TEXT NOT NULL, kayit_tarihi TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE urunler (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ad TEXT NOT NULL, kategori TEXT NOT NULL, fiyat REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE siparisler (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, musteri_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES musteriler(id),
                         tarih TEXT NOT NULL);  -- 'YYYY-MM-DD'
CREATE TABLE siparis_kalemleri (siparis_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES siparisler(id),
                                urun_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES urunler(id),
                                adet INTEGER NOT NULL, birim_fiyat REAL NOT NULL);
